command setupAudioClipsForStudent
	local tQuestionHash, tAnswerHash, tBlobID, tCounter
	local tQuestionText, tAnswerText, tQuestionType
	local tLanguage, tBlobPath, tEncSound
	
	put TTSLanguage into tLanguage
	if tLanguage is "en-us" then
		put "english" into tLanguage
	end if
	
	put 0 into tCounter
	repeat numberOfQuestions
		add 1 to tCounter
		put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionText"] into tQuestionText
		
		replace "____________________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText //20
		replace "___________________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "__________________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "_________________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "________________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "_______________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "______________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "_____________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "____________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "___________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "__________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "_________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "________" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText //8 = Default from AI
		replace "_______" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "______" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "_____" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "____" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		replace "___" with " BLANK " in tQuestionText
		
		put HashThis(tQuestionText) into tQuestionHash
		put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audio"]["question text"][tQuestionHash][TTSVoice][tLanguage] into tBlobID
		
		if tBlobID is not empty then
			put getBlob(tBlobID, true) into tBlobPath
			
			if tBlobPath is not empty then
				//put tBlobPath into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["audioClip"]
				put url("binfile:" & tBlobPath) into tEncSound
				put base64Encode(tEncSound) into tEncSound
				put tEncSound into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["audioClip"]
			end if
		end if
		
		put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionType"] into tQuestionType
		
		switch tQuestionType
			case "Multiple Choice"
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["choices"]["A"] into tAnswerText
				put HashThis(tAnswerText) into tAnswerHash
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audio"]["choices"]["A"][tAnswerHash][TTSVoice][tLanguage] into tBlobID
				if tBlobID is not empty then
					put getBlob(tBlobID, true) into tBlobPath
					
					if tBlobPath is not empty then
						//put tBlobPath into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["A"]
						put url("binfile:" & tBlobPath) into tEncSound
						put base64Encode(tEncSound) into tEncSound
						put tEncSound into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["A"]
					end if
				end if				
				
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["choices"]["B"] into tAnswerText
				put HashThis(tAnswerText) into tAnswerHash
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audio"]["choices"]["B"][tAnswerHash][TTSVoice][tLanguage] into tBlobID
				if tBlobID is not empty then
					put getBlob(tBlobID, true) into tBlobPath
					
					if tBlobPath is not empty then
						//put tBlobPath into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["B"]
						put url("binfile:" & tBlobPath) into tEncSound
						put base64Encode(tEncSound) into tEncSound
						put tEncSound into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["B"]
					end if
				end if		
				
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["choices"]["C"] into tAnswerText
				put HashThis(tAnswerText) into tAnswerHash
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audio"]["choices"]["C"][tAnswerHash][TTSVoice][tLanguage] into tBlobID
				if tBlobID is not empty then
					put getBlob(tBlobID, true) into tBlobPath
					
					if tBlobPath is not empty then
						//put tBlobPath into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["C"]
						put url("binfile:" & tBlobPath) into tEncSound
						put base64Encode(tEncSound) into tEncSound
						put tEncSound into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["C"]
					end if
				end if		
				
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["choices"]["D"] into tAnswerText
				put HashThis(tAnswerText) into tAnswerHash
				put currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audio"]["choices"]["D"][tAnswerHash][TTSVoice][tLanguage] into tBlobID
				if tBlobID is not empty then
					put getBlob(tBlobID, true) into tBlobPath
					
					if tBlobPath is not empty then
						//put tBlobPath into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["D"]
						put url("binfile:" & tBlobPath) into tEncSound
						put base64Encode(tEncSound) into tEncSound
						put tEncSound into currentQuizA["quiz"]["questions"][tCounter]["questionData"]["audioClips"]["D"]
					end if
				end if		
				break
			
			case "True / False"
				break
			
			case "Fill In"
				break
			
			case "Written"
				break
		end switch
	end repeat
end setupAudioClipsForStudent

function HashThis pDataToHash, pHashVersion
	local tHashOut
	
	if pHashVersion = "" then
		get binarydecode("H*",messagedigest(pDataToHash,"sha-256"),tHashOut)
	else
		get binarydecode("H*",messagedigest(pDataToHash,pHashVersion),tHashOut)
	end if
	
	return tHashOut
end HashThis
